findings.claim: isSafeMigrationCall recomputes the SAFE_VERSIONS.flatMap address list and re-decodes the migration interface selectors on every invocation, and since isSafeUpdateTxData is called from render paths, this address list and the four selectors should be hoisted to module-level constants (e.g. in safe-migrations.ts) instead of being recomputed each call.

The 1.5.0 test case only exercises the canonical selector and address; it should also include a case for the zksync variant address to lock in the 'any variant' matching behavior the guard now depends on, otherwise a future regression back to canonical-only matching would not be caught by the suite.

The negative test case only covers non-migrate calldata sent to a SafeMigration address; a symmetrical positive counter-example (a migrate selector sent to a non-SafeMigration address) is missing and would be needed to fully verify that the guard requires both the address and the selector to match.
